rules.name: Emirates NBD
rules.example: Purchase of AED 45.50 with Credit Card ending 1234 at CARREFOUR MOE, DUBAI. Avl Cr. Limit is AED 12,345.67.

rules.name: Emirates NBD
rules.pattern: (?i)(?<currency>AED)\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) has been debited from (?:your )?account (?:no\. )?[Xx*•.]*(?<account>\d{2,})(?: towards| for| to)? (?<payee>[^.\n]+?)\.
rules.example: AED 1,200.00 has been debited from your account XXX1234 towards DEWA BILL PAYMENT. Available balance is AED 8,400.00.

rules.name: ADCB
rules.example: Your Cr.Card XXX1234 was used for AED45.00 on 02/11/2026 10:20:11 at TALABAT,DUBAI-AE. Avl.Cr.limit is AED 9,876.00.

rules.name: First Abu Dhabi Bank
rules.example: Card ending 1234 used for AED 89.00 at LULU HYPERMARKET on 02 NOV 2026 18:40. Available limit AED 5,110.00.

rules.name: Mashreq
rules.pattern: (?i)(?<currency>AED)\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) was spent on your Mashreq (?:Credit |Debit )?Card ending (?<account>\d{2,}) at (?<payee>.+?) on
rules.example: AED 230.00 was spent on your Mashreq Card ending 1234 at AMAZON.AE on 02-NOV-2026. Available limit AED 4,770.00.

rules.name: Any bank (UAE)
rules.example: AED 15,000.00 has been credited to your account XXX1234 on 01-NOV-2026. Available balance is AED 23,400.00.
